hypotheses.reasoning: ingest-api's heap kept climbing. After full GC it was still at 78% (#86), then 87% with 35% GC overhead (#109), because old gen was not being reclaimed. That ended in OutOfMemoryError at eventCache.put (#130, #158) and OOMKills of ingest-api-0 and ingest-api-1 (#131, #159). Each 502 at the gateway comes right after a restart window and says 'connection reset (no healthy upstream)' (#141, #168, #184, #205). The bursty pattern matches pods crash-looping. The unbounded growth of eventCache is the likely leak. The one schema-validation DLQ message in event-processor (#41) is unrelated, and the other services logged no errors.
v3.26.6 may have added an unbounded eventCache, but no deploy event shows up in the window to confirm it.

verdict.recommendedAction: To stop the 502s, raise the ingest-api memory limit or reduce the eventCache size limit or time-to-live, and add replicas so a pod restart doesn't leave the gateway with no healthy backend. Then take a heap dump to find out why eventCache entries are never freed, bound the cache, and check whether the leak arrived with v3.26.6 (roll back if so).
